finding.title: SQL injection in Accounts::balance
finding.description: The account value is concatenated into the SQL text passed to the database instead of being bound as a parameter.

plan.hypothesis: If the input described for the exploit probe (account "alice' OR 1=1 --") reaches Accounts::balance without confinement or encoding, then: The SQL text the database double records contains the account "alice' OR 1=1 --" itself, so the input became query structure (an unaffected implementation passes it only as a bound parameter)

control.seam: Call the real Accounts::balance with an injected database handle object
control.property_to_assert: Returns the rows the database double returns (25) and issues exactly one query
control.doubles: RecordingDb::selectall_arrayref records the SQL and bind values unchanged and returns fixed rows; it neither builds nor quotes SQL

exploit.seam: Call the real Accounts::balance with an injected database handle object
exploit.property_to_assert: The SQL text the database double records contains the account "alice' OR 1=1 --" itself, so the input became query structure (an unaffected implementation passes it only as a bound parameter)
exploit.doubles: RecordingDb::selectall_arrayref records the SQL and bind values unchanged and returns fixed rows; it neither builds nor quotes SQL
